mentions.name: OrcaMarka
mentions.description: A web-based tool that simplifies reading web content on e-paper devices, split into two parts: a mobile-friendly app at app.orcamarka.com for bookmarking websites, text snippets, or images into a pure text format, and a reader site at m.orcamarka.com optimized for the limited browsers on devices like the Kindle (auto-redirecting to the app for capable browsers). The reader displays a QR code that can be scanned with the app to sync and load saved text without typing URLs on E-ink. It is a free web app with no installation required, and the author is seeking beta testers for workflow feedback.
mentions.problem: Reading web content on e-paper devices is painful due to limited device browsers and the difficulty of typing URLs on E-ink screens.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on OrcaMarka, a tool designed to simplify reading web content on e-paper devices.
